SRC-018:R001.text: CORE-001 preset identity: canonical activation routine keyed by stable preset ID; ComboBox bound to IDs not display names; Save As/Update/Rename/Delete act on the visible selection; fail closed on desync

SRC-018:R002.text: CORE-002 target selectability: one resolver from Load-Targets rules used by preset loading; only selectable targets checked; unavailable members retained and reported; no folder dialogs from preset selection

SRC-018:R003.text: CORE-003 Rename-Preset: acquire presets.lock before source existence check and Read-PresetFile; hold continuously through validate/rename/removal; no stale pre-lock state

SRC-018:R004.text: CORE-004 PATH_TARGETS: one canonical GUI-owned mapping for zcode/notepadplusplus/cinema4d; reachable folder picker and persistence; CLI-owned keys preserved; preset load never prompts

SRC-018:R005.text: CORE-005 Test-PresetObject: validate every snapshot token value against canonical six-digit hex; reject whole preset before GUI mutation with token name and reason

SRC-018:R006.text: CORE-006 preset dirty state: normalized staged-state snapshot incl custom tokens and sorted target IDs; ItemCheck uses pending NewValue; recapture baseline after load/Save As/Update

SRC-018:R007.text: W2-001 Notepad++ and Cinema 4D persistent first-touch ownership and recovery

SRC-018:R008.text: W2-002 generation/batch lock: cover explicit Target, Target all, Selected and Reapply consumers; lock held across check and consumption; Reapply single generation epoch

SRC-018:R009.text: W2-003 Reapply ZCodePath: forward explicit -ZCodePath like CodeNomadPath/WorkBuddyPath through the canonical path-bearing parameter map

SRC-018:R010.text: W2-004 Reapply unknown manifest targets: separate supported recorded targets from unknown preserved ones; unknown never dispatched, never failed, preserved unchanged, reported

SRC-018:R011.text: W2-005 paths.json fail-closed: file present but unreadable aborts with original bytes preserved in both Save-PathPreference and GUI Save-CustomPaths; absent file initializes; unknown valid keys preserved

SRC-018:R012.text: W2-006 dir-prestate cleanup: success-disposal helper used at every Save-DirPreState call site; no wintage-dirstate-* left after successful apply/revert; failed rollback keeps snapshot

SRC-018:R013.text: PERF-001 CSSOM invalidation: replaceSync/insertRule/deleteRule set stylesDirty and arm one coalesced continuation; replace() invalidates on Promise fulfillment only and returns original Promise; rejection no-op

SRC-018:R014.text: PERF-002 onMutations stylesheet detection: collect O(1) then dedupe connected roots before one retained-root STYLE/LINK query; truncation sets stylesDirty conservatively without tail walk

SRC-018:R015.text: PERF-003 suspendRepainter disposal: clear forceLapDeferredRoots/styleLapDeferredRoots, null activeStyleTask/styleCursorRoot/styleCursorRootIterator, reset style cursor/debt state; idempotent

SRC-018:R016.text: PERF-004 GoodEmoji idle sweep: remove unconditional 2s full-body query; keep bootstrap + MutationObserver; bounded adaptive reconciliation only after relevant activity
